reuse.why: Hooks the rule into the existing shared assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount functions that every provider already calls, with no per-provider edits.

duplication.why: The closed-account check is written twice, once as a separate query in assertBankAccountNotLinked and again on accRow in linkBankSyncAccount; the shared error constant hides that it is the same rule.

placement.why: The shared link path is the right layer, but the check is put in a function named for the already-linked rule, so its name no longer says what it checks, and it is repeated in the upgrade branch.

scope.why: Only the link guard, the shared link function and a release note change.

maintainability.why: Two checks of the same rule in consecutive steps, one inside a misnamed function, will confuse a maintainer about which check counts.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link functions keep going through assertBankAccountNotLinked and linkBankSyncAccount.

disguised_duplication.where: The closed check appears as a separate SELECT closed query in assertBankAccountNotLinked and again as accRow.closed === 1 in linkBankSyncAccount, the same rule written as two different checks.

one_place.where: The closed rule is decided both in assertBankAccountNotLinked and in the upgrade branch of linkBankSyncAccount (packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts); every path runs both.
